title: The LORD Looks at the Heart

request.style: English, country ballad, warm male vocal, acoustic guitar, pedal steel, fiddle, piano, soft drums, nostalgic and tender, 80 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
Old Samuel came to Bethlehem with a horn of oil in hand
Jesse lined up all his sons, the finest in the land
Eliab stood the tallest, he looked every inch a king
But the LORD said, not this one, I'm looking at a different thing

[Chorus]
The LORD does not see as man sees
Man looks at the outward appearance
But the LORD looks at the heart
The LORD looks at the heart

[Verse]
Seven sons went walking by, and seven times God said no
Are these all the young men you have, the prophet asked him slow
There is still the youngest, he is out tending the sheep
Send for him, we will not sit down, this promise God will keep

[Chorus]
The LORD does not see as man sees
Man looks at the outward appearance
But the LORD looks at the heart
The LORD looks at the heart

[Bridge]
Rise and anoint him, this is the one
The shepherd boy with the dust of the hills
And from that day on the Spirit of the LORD
Came powerfully upon David

[Outro]
The LORD looks at the heart
